{{Quote|O Ziro the Hutt, Master of the Hutt Clan on seven systems, I am sorry, your highness. It will not happen again.|[[KRONOS-327/Legends|KRONOS-327]] to [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]]|<ref name="TCWf" />}}
'''Master of the Hutt Clan''' was a prestigious title by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Clan]] for various [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] had claimed this title for seven systems.<ref name="TCWf" />
